title: Mind R424 Claim-to-Source / Permission / Price / Return Gate Matrix
scope: source-controlled editorial and prospective pre-sell only

claims.claim: Simons/Chabris published dynamic unexpected-object study in 1999
claims.limitation: Do not apply a universal non-detection rate; difficulty/similarity change outcomes

claims.limitation: Not a test of general intelligence or perception training

claims.limitation: Experimental sample, not population prevalence

claims.claim: Eye tracking showed many missed figure despite gaze at its location
claims.limitation: Looking at location not same as conscious recognition

claims.claim: 2010 foreknowledge did not improve detection of additional surprises
claims.limitation: Not proof attention training is impossible

claims.claim: Inattentional blindness differs from change blindness

authoritative_inference_rule: Seller description establishes only seller-stated packaging. Scientific primary study does not validate named products. Gmail consumer promotions do not authenticate publisher permissions.
tests_to_run: proximate disclosure even with JS disabled
no merchant checkout or affiliate href while gates closed
no product medical/wealth claims in promotion
validate all internal canonical paths and mobile layouts
price and return terms re-read at exact approved tracking destination
confirmed paid order plus settlement net of fees/refunds, separate from affiliate_click
